title: Translate our menu into Spanish and Mandarin
summary: Many of our customers are more comfortable reading Spanish or Mandarin. We need our one-page menu translated so everyone can order with confidence.
tasks: Translate the 30-item menu into Spanish
Translate the same menu into Simplified Chinese
Keep dish names in English with the translation underneath
done_when: Both translations are delivered as editable Word or Google Docs files
A native speaker has proofread each version
Prices and item numbers match the English menu exactly
reward: Verified portfolio entry plus a free lunch for two

title: Clean up our inventory spreadsheet
summary: Our inventory lives in one giant Excel file that nobody understands anymore. We want a simple sheet that shows what is low on stock.
tasks: Merge the three duplicate product tabs into one
Add a column that flags items below a reorder level
Write a one-page how-to for staff
done_when: One tab lists every product exactly once
Low-stock items turn red automatically
A staff member can follow the how-to without help
reward: Verified portfolio entry plus 15% off at the store for a year

title: Design a flyer for our fall food drive
summary: We are collecting canned food in November and need an eye-catching flyer for local shops and the De Anza campus.
tasks: Design a one-page flyer with date, drop-off locations, and wanted items
Make a printable PDF and a square version for Instagram
Include a QR code that links to our sign-up form
done_when: Printable PDF and Instagram image are delivered
QR code scans and opens the sign-up form
All dates and addresses are approved by our coordinator
reward: Verified portfolio entry and volunteer-hours letter

title: Set up online appointment booking
summary: Customers call to book bike tune-ups and we miss calls when we are busy. We want people to book a time slot online.
tasks: Compare two free booking tools and recommend one
Set up the chosen tool with our services and hours
Add a Book Now button to our website
done_when: A test booking shows up in the shop's calendar
Customers get a confirmation email
Owner can block off days without help
reward: Verified portfolio entry plus a free bike tune-up

title: Fix our Google Maps listing
summary: Our Google listing shows the wrong hours and an old phone number, so people show up when we are closed.
tasks: Help us claim and verify the Google Business Profile
Update hours, phone number, and photos
Add holiday hours for the next three months
done_when: Google search shows the correct hours and phone
At least five new photos are on the listing
Owner knows how to log in and edit it
reward: Verified portfolio entry plus a bouquet of your choice

title: Build a simple volunteer sign-up page
summary: Parents sign up to coach and run snack duty through a messy email chain. We need one page where volunteers can pick a slot.
tasks: Create a sign-up form with game dates and roles
Show which slots are still open
Send a reminder email two days before each game
done_when: Parents can sign up from a phone in under a minute
Filled slots disappear from the list
Reminder email arrives on schedule in a test run
reward: Verified portfolio entry and a reference letter from the league board

title: Make our website accessible for screen readers
summary: A patient told us our site is hard to use with a screen reader. We want to fix the biggest problems so everyone can book a visit.
tasks: Run an accessibility checker on the five main pages
Add alt text to images and labels to form fields
Fix color contrast on buttons and links
done_when: Automated checker reports no critical errors
The booking form can be completed using only a keyboard
A short report lists what was fixed
reward: Verified portfolio entry and a LinkedIn recommendation from the practice owner
